title: A relative import that climbs out of its layer
rule: core sits below edge, so core may not import edge
why: acme/core/leaf.py writes `from ..edge.thing import upper`, which resolves to acme.edge.thing — the same dependency an absolute spelling would create, and the same one the stack forbids. This is the head-to-head case: all three tools can state the rule, so all three should catch it.
